text.p: Cypros Pharmaceutical Corp said on Tuesday it expects product sales to double with the acquisition of ethamolin injection.
The rights were acquired from Schwarz Pharma Inc for $3.2 million in staged payments, Cypros said.
Simultaneously, the company said, it entered into a three-year agreement with Schering-Plough Corp for the manufacture of ethamolin in finished form.
This continues Cypros' strategy to build a hospital sales force and near-term profitability around acquired products that serve the same market as its development-stage products.
"Ethamolin should immediately double the company's revenues from product sales, and facilitate our sales force expansion," Chief Executive Paul J. Marangos said.
"This new addition to our portfolio of marketed products will bring Cypros one step closer to reaching its goal of profitability.
"Additional acquisitions and late-stage product development opportunities are being evaluated to expand our near-term product portfolio," he added.

Ethamolin is an injectable drug approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for the treatment of varices that bleed into the esophagus and stomach, an often fatal event. This is common in patients with severe liver disease, and comprises 15 to 20 percent of all gastrointestinal hemorrhages.

Ethamolin is the only approved agent for this medical condition. Ethamolin is well established, but under-utilized, due to an absence of promotion efforts over the last few years, Cypros said. Since it is the company's third acute-care drug on the market, Cypros will be devoting significant sales force time and marketing effort to expanding the sales of Ethamolin in the hospital setting, it said.
